hero.title: Compliance you can prove.
hero.subtitle: Turn audits into automated checks.
hero.description: CANONIC Foundation certifies governed software. Instead of a once-a-year scramble, compliance becomes a continuous score your customers can verify anytime. In plain terms: your repo becomes the audit trail.

quote.bold: Trust closes deals. Proof closes them faster.
quote.rest: Foundation gives buyers a simple answer to a hard question: does this system follow the rules we care about?

sections.title: The Language
sections.description: Governance sounds abstract until you make it concrete. CANONIC starts with three artifacts that any team can understand: a contract (rules), a design language (interface), and a spec (requirements).

cards.title: 📋 Contract (Rules)
cards.text: What is required, what is forbidden, and what “done” means. This is how you keep teams aligned and regulators calm.

cards.title: 🎨 Design (Interface)
cards.text: One visual language across every surface. Familiar UI reduces friction and makes governance feel natural, not bureaucratic.

cards.title: 📐 Spec (Requirements)
cards.text: Standards become tests. Tests become a score. A score becomes a receipt your customer can verify.

tabs.label: Founders
tabs.title: Sell trust, not slides.
tabs.text: Enterprise buyers do not buy promises. They buy risk reduction. Foundation gives you a public, verifiable compliance posture that survives vendor diligence.
bullets: Always up to date, not annual
tabs.footnote: Layperson translation: “governed” means the rules are written down and the system can prove it followed them.

tabs.label: Engineers
tabs.title: Make compliance a CI gate.
tabs.text: Instead of spreadsheets and meetings, you get deterministic checks on every commit. If it passes, it ships. If it fails, it stops.

tabs.label: Security
tabs.title: Evidence, not narratives.
tabs.text: Security teams need audit-ready artifacts: who changed what, when, and why. Foundation treats those artifacts as first-class outputs.

sections.title: Three Axioms
sections.description: Three first principles keep the system simple enough to explain to a non-technical buyer and strict enough to enforce in code.

cards.title: TRIAD
cards.text: Every scope declares its rules, vocabulary, and plain-language purpose. Like a passport: identity, language, intent.

cards.title: INHERITANCE
cards.text: Governance flows from parent to child. A regulated domain inherits constraints. A product inherits them too. No loopholes.

cards.title: INTROSPECTION
cards.text: The system checks itself. Undefined terms and missing evidence get flagged before humans have to debate them.

quote.rest: That is what makes certification possible.

sections.title: The Tools
sections.description: Foundation certification is powered by automated validation. Your organization gets a repeatable process, not a yearly fire drill.

feature.title: Continuous certification for real teams.
feature.text: Validation runs where you build: in your repos, your CI, your workflow. Every change is checked against standards and governance boundaries.

cards.title: ✅ Certify
cards.text: We scan your entire organization and score every project. Certification is public, verifiable, and permanent — a trust signal your customers can check in seconds.

cards.title: 🔄 Validate
cards.text: Automated checks run on every commit. If it passes, it ships. If it doesn’t, it stops. No exceptions, no escalation meetings, no finger-pointing.

cards.title: 🤝 Pair
cards.text: We match certified developers with regulated industries. The right builder for the right problem, with a verified track record that speaks for itself.

cards.title: 🏛 Govern
cards.text: We oversee the project to completion. Every deliverable validated. Every milestone verified. Every dollar accounted for. Governance that earns its keep.

sections.title: 21 Governed Domains
sections.description: 14 verticals, 4 regulatory, 2 horizontal, 1 meta. Every compliance framework is a cost center — until you automate it. We turn mandatory overhead into a competitive advantage across every regulated industry.

cards.title: Finance
cards.subtitle: SOC2, PCI DSS, SOX, Basel III

sections.title: The Library
sections.description: Everything we know, published for free. The theory, the economics, the protocol, the sector playbooks. Open infrastructure makes the whole ecosystem stronger.

cards.title: 📖 The Theory
cards.text: The mathematical proof behind governed economics. Why validated work creates durable value — and speculation doesn’t.

cards.title: 💎 The Economics
cards.text: How the token model works. How contributors earn. How value flows from specification to product to market.

cards.title: 📐 The Protocol
cards.text: The complete validation protocol. 80+ compliance standards mapped to 8 dimensions. One file your team can adopt today.

cards.title: 🗺 Industry Guides
cards.text: Industry-specific playbooks for 21 domains including healthcare, finance, defense, robotics, automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, energy, and more. Written by practitioners, not consultants.

feature.title: Specification beats speculation.
feature.text: Protocols can create enormous value. CANONIC is built for regulated reality: standards, evidence, and repeatability. Value comes from validated work and provable compliance, not hype.

feature.title: MAGIC is how you operate the standard.
feature.text: Foundation defines certification. MAGIC runs the operational layer: tiers, commerce, and services. Want to see it in motion? Hadley Lab is the live beta ground where governed products ship.

cta.title: Ready to make compliance easy?
cta.description: Start with the Foundation language, then use MAGIC to ship governed services. Hadley Lab shows the product surface end-to-end.
